ARG RUNTIME_IMAGE=aquadactyl:test
FROM ${RUNTIME_IMAGE}
WORKDIR /bench
ENV COMPOSER_ALLOW_SUPERUSER=1
COPY panel/composer.json panel/composer.lock ./
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/tmp/benchmark-composer \
    COMPOSER_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/benchmark-composer composer install \
    --no-dev --no-interaction --no-scripts --no-autoloader --prefer-dist --no-progress
COPY panel/ ./
COPY harness/ /harness/
RUN composer dump-autoload --no-dev --optimize --no-scripts \
    && sed -i 's/\r$//' /harness/entrypoint.sh \
    && composer check-platform-reqs --no-dev \
    && mkdir -p bootstrap/cache storage/logs storage/framework/cache/data storage/framework/sessions storage/framework/views var extensions public/assets/extensions \
    && chown -R nginx:nginx storage bootstrap/cache var extensions public/assets/extensions \
    && cp /harness/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/nginx.conf \
    && cp /harness/php-fpm.conf /usr/local/etc/php-fpm.conf
EXPOSE 80
ENTRYPOINT ["/bin/sh", "/harness/entrypoint.sh"]

# Common runtime for both applications; application sources are installed separately.
FROM php:8.4-fpm-alpine
RUN apk add --no-cache nginx supervisor curl git unzip icu-dev libzip-dev \
      libpng-dev libjpeg-turbo-dev libwebp-dev oniguruma-dev $PHPIZE_DEPS \
    && docker-php-ext-configure gd --with-jpeg --with-webp \
    && docker-php-ext-install -j4 bcmath gd intl mbstring pdo_mysql zip opcache \
    && pecl install redis-6.3.0 \
    && docker-php-ext-enable redis \
    && apk del $PHPIZE_DEPS
RUN apk add --no-cache mariadb-client
COPY --from=composer:2 /usr/bin/composer /usr/local/bin/composer
RUN printf '%s\n' 'memory_limit=256M' 'opcache.enable=1' \
      'opcache.memory_consumption=128' 'opcache.interned_strings_buffer=16' \
      'opcache.max_accelerated_files=20000' 'opcache.validate_timestamps=0' \
      > /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/99-benchmark.ini

#!/bin/sh
set -eu
cd /bench
php artisan package:discover --no-interaction
php artisan migrate --force --no-interaction
php /harness/seed.php
test -s storage/benchmark-access.json
php artisan config:cache
php artisan route:cache
php artisan view:cache
chown -R nginx:nginx storage bootstrap/cache
exec supervisord -n -c /harness/supervisord.conf

[global]
error_log = /proc/self/fd/2
daemonize = no
[www]
user = nginx
group = nginx
listen = 127.0.0.1:9000
pm = static
pm.max_children = 4
pm.max_requests = 0
clear_env = no
catch_workers_output = yes
decorate_workers_output = no

<?php

// Only used inside the disposable benchmark stack. Never run against a real panel.
if (getenv('PANEL_RUNTIME_BENCHMARK') !== 'disposable-fixture') {
    throw new RuntimeException('Benchmark fixture environment is required.');
}
require '/bench/vendor/autoload.php';
$app = require '/bench/bootstrap/app.php';
$app->make(Illuminate\Contracts\Console\Kernel::class)->bootstrap();

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Pterodactyl\Models\ApiKey;
use Pterodactyl\Models\User;
use Pterodactyl\Services\Api\KeyCreationService;

$access = '/bench/storage/benchmark-access.json';
// Laravel's console exception renderer may return exit code zero for standalone
// scripts. Fixture failures must stop the container instead of passing health checks.
set_exception_handler(function (Throwable $error): never {
    fwrite(STDERR, $error->getMessage() . PHP_EOL);
    exit(1);
});
if (User::query()->exists()) {
    if (!file_exists($access)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Existing database has no benchmark credentials; use fresh volumes.');
    }
    exit(0);
}

$user = User::forceCreate([
    'uuid' => '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001',
    'username' => 'benchmark',
    'email' => 'benchmark@example.test',
    'name_first' => 'Benchmark',
    'name_last' => 'Account',
    'password' => Hash::make(getenv('BENCHMARK_PASSWORD')),
    'root_admin' => false,
    'language' => 'en',
    'use_totp' => false,
]);
$now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
$location = DB::table('locations')->insertGetId(['short' => 'bench', 'long' => 'Benchmark fixture', 'created_at' => $now, 'updated_at' => $now]);
$node = DB::table('nodes')->insertGetId([
    'uuid' => '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002', 'public' => true,
    'name' => 'Benchmark Node', 'description' => 'Fixture only; no daemon or game server is contacted.',
    'location_id' => $location, 'fqdn' => '127.0.0.1', 'scheme' => 'http', 'behind_proxy' => false,
    'memory' => 32768, 'memory_overallocate' => 0, 'disk' => 1048576, 'disk_overallocate' => 0,
    'upload_size' => 100, 'daemon_token_id' => Str::random(16), 'daemon_token' => encrypt(Str::random(64)),
    'daemonListen' => 19999, 'daemonSFTP' => 2022, 'daemonBase' => '/tmp/benchmark-servers',
    'created_at' => $now, 'updated_at' => $now,
]);
$nest = DB::table('nests')->insertGetId(['uuid' => '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003', 'author' => 'benchmark@example.test', 'name' => 'Benchmark', 'description' => 'Fixture', 'created_at' => $now, 'updated_at' => $now]);
$egg = DB::table('eggs')->insertGetId([
    'uuid' => '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004', 'nest_id' => $nest,
    'author' => 'benchmark@example.test', 'name' => 'Benchmark Egg', 'description' => 'No game execution',
    'docker_images' => json_encode(['Fixture' => 'alpine:3.22']), 'startup' => 'echo benchmark',
    'config_files' => '{}', 'config_startup' => '{}', 'config_logs' => '{}', 'config_stop' => 'stop',
    'script_install' => '', 'script_is_privileged' => false, 'script_entry' => 'sh', 'script_container' => 'alpine:3.22',
    'created_at' => $now, 'updated_at' => $now,
]);
for ($i = 1; $i <= 50; $i++) {
    $allocation = DB::table('allocations')->insertGetId(['node_id' => $node, 'ip' => '127.0.0.1', 'port' => 30000 + $i, 'created_at' => $now, 'updated_at' => $now]);
    $server = [
        'uuid' => sprintf('10000000-0000-4000-8000-%012d', $i),
        'name' => sprintf('Benchmark Server %02d', $i), 'description' => 'Identical database fixture; no running daemon.',
        'node_id' => $node, 'owner_id' => $user->id, 'memory' => 1024, 'swap' => 0, 'disk' => 4096,
        'io' => 500, 'cpu' => 100, 'oom_disabled' => true, 'allocation_id' => $allocation,
        'nest_id' => $nest, 'egg_id' => $egg, 'startup' => 'echo benchmark', 'image' => 'alpine:3.22',
        'database_limit' => 0, 'allocation_limit' => 1, 'backup_limit' => 0,
        'status' => 'suspended', 'created_at' => $now, 'updated_at' => $now, 'installed_at' => $now,
    ];
    if (Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema::hasColumn('servers', 'uuidShort')) {
        $server['uuidShort'] = sprintf('%08x', $i);
    }
    $id = DB::table('servers')->insertGetId($server);
    DB::table('allocations')->where('id', $allocation)->update(['server_id' => $id]);
}
if (class_exists(KeyCreationService::class)) {
    $key = $app->make(KeyCreationService::class)->setKeyType(ApiKey::TYPE_ACCOUNT)->handle([
        'user_id' => $user->id, 'memo' => 'Disposable benchmark', 'allowed_ips' => [],
    ]);
} else {
    // v2 removed KeyCreationService; create the same legacy Sanctum client key.
    $key = $user->apiKeys()->forceCreate([
        'identifier' => ApiKey::generateTokenIdentifier(ApiKey::TYPE_ACCOUNT),
        'key_type' => ApiKey::TYPE_ACCOUNT,
        'token' => encrypt(Str::random(ApiKey::KEY_LENGTH)),
        'memo' => 'Disposable benchmark', 'allowed_ips' => [],
    ]);
}
file_put_contents($access, json_encode([
    'username' => $user->username, 'password' => getenv('BENCHMARK_PASSWORD'),
    'token' => $key->identifier . decrypt($key->token),
]));
chmod($access, 0600);
echo "Created matching benchmark fixture: one user, one node, one egg, 50 suspended server records.\n";

[supervisord]
nodaemon=true
user=root
logfile=/tmp/benchmark-supervisor.log
pidfile=/tmp/benchmark-supervisor.pid
[program:php-fpm]
command=/usr/local/sbin/php-fpm -F
autostart=true
autorestart=true
stdout_logfile=/dev/stdout
stdout_logfile_maxbytes=0
stderr_logfile=/dev/stderr
stderr_logfile_maxbytes=0
[program:nginx]
command=/usr/sbin/nginx -g 'daemon off;'
autostart=true
autorestart=true
[program:queue]
command=/usr/local/bin/php /bench/artisan queue:work --queue=high,standard,low --sleep=3 --tries=3
user=nginx
autostart=true
autorestart=true

    $allocation = DB::table('allocations')->insertGetId(['node_id' => $node, 'ip' => '127.0.0.1', 'port' => 30000 + $i, 'created_at' => $now, 'updated_at' => $now]);
    $server = [
        'uuid' => sprintf('10000000-0000-4000-8000-%012d', $i),
        'name' => sprintf('Benchmark Server %02d', $i), 'description' => 'Identical database fixture; no running daemon.',
        'node_id' => $node, 'owner_id' => $user->id, 'memory' => 1024, 'swap' => 0, 'disk' => 4096,
        'io' => 500, 'cpu' => 100, 'oom_disabled' => true, 'allocation_id' => $allocation,
        'nest_id' => $nest, 'egg_id' => $egg, 'startup' => 'echo benchmark', 'image' => 'alpine:3.22',
        'database_limit' => 0, 'allocation_limit' => 1, 'backup_limit' => 0,
        'status' => 'suspended', 'created_at' => $now, 'updated_at' => $now, 'installed_at' => $now,
    ];
    if (Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema::hasColumn('servers', 'uuidShort')) {
        $server['uuidShort'] = sprintf('%08x', $i);
    }
    $id = DB::table('servers')->insertGetId($server);
    DB::table('allocations')->where('id', $allocation)->update(['server_id' => $id]);
}
if (class_exists(KeyCreationService::class)) {
    $key = $app->make(KeyCreationService::class)->setKeyType(ApiKey::TYPE_ACCOUNT)->handle([
        'user_id' => $user->id, 'memo' => 'Disposable benchmark', 'allowed_ips' => [],
    ]);
} else {
    // v2 removed KeyCreationService; create the same legacy Sanctum client key.
    $key = $user->apiKeys()->forceCreate([
        'identifier' => ApiKey::generateTokenIdentifier(ApiKey::TYPE_ACCOUNT),
        'key_type' => ApiKey::TYPE_ACCOUNT,
        'token' => encrypt(Str::random(ApiKey::KEY_LENGTH)),
        'memo' => 'Disposable benchmark', 'allowed_ips' => [],
    ]);
}
file_put_contents($access, json_encode([
    'username' => $user->username, 'password' => getenv('BENCHMARK_PASSWORD'),
    'token' => $key->identifier . decrypt($key->token),
]));
chmod($access, 0600);
echo "Created matching benchmark fixture: one user, one node, one egg, 50 suspended server records.\n";

<?php
// Disposable benchmark databases only. Run after the panel measurement phase.
if (getenv('PANEL_RUNTIME_BENCHMARK') !== 'disposable-fixture') {
    throw new RuntimeException('Refusing a non-benchmark database.');
}
require '/bench/vendor/autoload.php';
$app = require '/bench/bootstrap/app.php';
$app->make(Illuminate\Contracts\Console\Kernel::class)->bootstrap();
set_exception_handler(function (Throwable $e): never { fwrite(STDERR, $e->getMessage() . "\n"); exit(1); });
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Pterodactyl\Models\{Node,User};
$variant = $argv[1];
if (!in_array($variant, ['manta', 'wings'], true)) throw new RuntimeException('Unknown benchmark variant.');
$password = getenv('DAEMON_BENCHMARK_PASSWORD');
if (!$password || !getenv('DAEMON_BENCHMARK_HOST')) throw new RuntimeException('Missing private setup environment.');
if (DB::table('nodes')->where('name', 'like', 'Benchmark Daemon%')->exists()) throw new RuntimeException('Use fresh fixtures; daemon benchmark is already provisioned.');
$now = date('Y-m-d H:i:s');
$timestamps = ['created_at'=>$now,'updated_at'=>$now];
DB::beginTransaction();
$owner = User::forceCreate(['uuid'=>'00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000099','username'=>'benchmark-daemon',
    'email'=>'daemon@example.test','name_first'=>'Benchmark','name_last'=>'Daemon','password'=>Hash::make($password),
    'root_admin'=>false,'language'=>'en','use_totp'=>false]);
$root = '/benchdata/'.$variant;
$port = $variant === 'manta' ? 18083 : 18084;
$sftp = $variant === 'manta' ? 2023 : 2024;
$nodeId = DB::table('nodes')->insertGetId($timestamps + [
    'uuid'=>(string)Str::uuid(),'name'=>'Benchmark Daemon '.ucfirst($variant),'description'=>'Isolated current-release benchmark',
    'location_id'=>DB::table('locations')->value('id'),'fqdn'=>getenv('DAEMON_BENCHMARK_HOST'),'scheme'=>'http',
    'public'=>false,'behind_proxy'=>false,'memory'=>8192,'disk'=>32768,'memory_overallocate'=>0,'disk_overallocate'=>0,
    'upload_size'=>100,'daemon_token_id'=>Str::random(16),'daemon_token'=>encrypt(Str::random(64)),
    'daemonListen'=>$port,'daemonSFTP'=>$sftp,'daemonBase'=>$root.'/volumes',
]);
$nest = DB::table('nests')->value('id');
$servers = [];
foreach (['paper','bedrock'] as $kind) {
    $gamePort = ($variant === 'manta' ? 27015 : 27115) + ($kind === 'bedrock' ? 1 : 0);
    $image = getenv($kind === 'paper' ? 'BENCHMARK_PAPER_IMAGE' : 'BENCHMARK_BEDROCK_IMAGE');
    if (!$image || !str_contains($image, '@sha256:')) throw new RuntimeException('Pin game images by digest.');
    $startup = $kind === 'paper'
        ? 'java -Xms128M -Xmx1400M -Dterminal.jline=false -Dterminal.ansi=true -jar server.jar --nogui'
        : 'LD_LIBRARY_PATH=. ./bedrock_server';
    $egg = DB::table('eggs')->insertGetId($timestamps + [
        'uuid'=>(string)Str::uuid(),'nest_id'=>$nest,'author'=>'benchmark@example.test','name'=>'Benchmark '.ucfirst($kind),
        'description'=>'Matching cached binaries; no timed installation or download.',
        'docker_images'=>json_encode(['Benchmark'=>$image]),'startup'=>$startup,
        'config_files'=>'{}','config_startup'=>json_encode(['done'=>$kind==='paper'?'Done (':'Server started.']),
        'config_logs'=>'{}','config_stop'=>'stop','script_install'=>'','script_is_privileged'=>false,
        'script_entry'=>'sh','script_container'=>'alpine:3.22',
    ]);
    $allocation = DB::table('allocations')->insertGetId($timestamps + ['node_id'=>$nodeId,'ip'=>'127.0.0.1','port'=>$gamePort]);
    $uuid = (string)Str::uuid();
    $name = 'Benchmark '.ucfirst($variant).' '.ucfirst($kind);
    $record = $timestamps + [
        'uuid'=>$uuid,'name'=>$name,'description'=>'Dedicated benchmark fixture',
        'node_id'=>$nodeId,'owner_id'=>$owner->id,'memory'=>$kind==='paper'?1536:512,'swap'=>0,'disk'=>4096,
        'io'=>500,'cpu'=>200,'oom_disabled'=>false,'allocation_id'=>$allocation,'nest_id'=>$nest,'egg_id'=>$egg,
        'startup'=>$startup,'image'=>$image,'database_limit'=>0,'allocation_limit'=>2,'backup_limit'=>2,
        'status'=>null,'installed_at'=>$now,
    ];
    if (Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema::hasColumn('servers','uuidShort')) $record['uuidShort'] = substr($uuid,0,8);
    $id = DB::table('servers')->insertGetId($record);
    DB::table('allocations')->where('id',$allocation)->update(['server_id'=>$id]);
    if ($kind === 'bedrock') DB::table('allocations')->insert($timestamps + ['node_id'=>$nodeId,'ip'=>'127.0.0.1','port'=>$gamePort+1,'server_id'=>$id]);
    $servers[] = ['id'=>$id,'uuid'=>$uuid,'name'=>$name,'kind'=>$kind,'identifier'=>substr($uuid,0,8),'port'=>$gamePort];
}
$node = Node::findOrFail($nodeId);
$config = $node->getConfiguration();
$config['remote'] = 'http://benchmark-panel';
$config['allowed_origins'] = ['http://benchmark-panel'];
$config['ignore_panel_config_updates'] = true;
$config['system'] = array_replace_recursive($config['system'], [
    'root_directory'=>$root,'log_directory'=>$root.'/logs','archive_directory'=>$root.'/archives',
    'backup_directory'=>$root.'/backups','tmp_directory'=>$root.'/tmp','timezone'=>'UTC',
    'username'=>$variant==='manta'?'aquadactyl':'pterodactyl',
    'user'=>['uid'=>988,'gid'=>988],
    'machine_id'=>['directory'=>$root.'/machine-id'],'passwd'=>['directory'=>$root.'/etc'],
]);
$subnet = $variant === 'manta' ? '172.30.21' : '172.30.22';
$config['docker']['network'] = ['name'=>'benchmark-'.$variant,'network_mode'=>'benchmark-'.$variant,
    'bridge_name'=>'bench-'.substr($variant,0,5),'interface'=>$subnet.'.1',
    'interfaces'=>['v4'=>['subnet'=>$subnet.'.0/24','gateway'=>$subnet.'.1'],'v6'=>['enabled'=>false]]];
$private = [
    'node'=>['id'=>$nodeId,'name'=>$node->name,'container'=>$variant,'base'=>'http://172.17.0.1:'.$port,
        'token'=>$node->getDecryptedKey(),'sftp_port'=>$sftp,'data_root'=>$root,'servers'=>$servers],
    'yaml'=>Symfony\Component\Yaml\Yaml::dump($config,10,2,Symfony\Component\Yaml\Yaml::DUMP_EMPTY_ARRAY_AS_SEQUENCE),
];
file_put_contents('/bench/storage/daemon-benchmark-'.$variant.'.json', json_encode($private,JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));
chmod('/bench/storage/daemon-benchmark-'.$variant.'.json',0600);
DB::commit();
echo "Provisioned disposable ".$variant." fixtures.\n";

FROM alpine:3.22
RUN apk add --no-cache ca-certificates tzdata shadow coreutils \
    && addgroup -g 988 benchmark \
    && adduser -D -H -u 988 -G benchmark aquadactyl \
    && useradd -M -N -o -u 988 -g 988 pterodactyl \
    && cp /bin/busybox /usr/local/bin/busybox
COPY manta /usr/local/bin/manta
COPY wings /usr/local/bin/wings
COPY runner /usr/local/bin/benchmark-runner
